outcome: Give CPG teams a working On-Shelf Availability & Perfect-Store Execution capability on their own data — it recovers lost sales by closing the 'trillion-dollar out-of-stock' gap.
overview: The shelf is where a CPG brand wins or loses the sale, and out-of-stocks and poor execution drain revenue quietly — industry analyses size the global out-of-stock gap in the trillions of dollars. On-Shelf Availability & Perfect-Store Execution reads store photographs captured by field teams, detects facings, share-of-shelf and empty space, then cross-checks POS and inventory movement so an alert reflects a real availability problem rather than a camera angle. Territory managers still choose where to send people; the system tells them where the loss sits. Redington runs a five-to-six week MVP on the customer’s own images, planograms and sell-out data, against a compliance baseline agreed beforehand.
